description: Several corpus cases (labels_wrap 0.80, integration_wide_labels 0.81, labels_unicode ~0.82) have structural similarity ~1.0 and identical geometry yet cap at ~0.80 SSIM because selkie renders labels as SVG <tspan> lines while mermaid uses HTML <foreignObject> divs; the residual is glyph-placement/antialiasing between the two rendering models, not a layout bug. An htmlLabels:false reference experiment REGRESSED -5.2pt (reverted). To close: either selkie adopts foreignObject-equivalent text, or the eval rasterizes both sides through the same engine (mmdc/Chrome for selkie too). Large effort; tracks the visual ceiling for text-heavy diagrams.
title: flowchart: text rendering-model gap — SVG tspan vs mermaid HTML foreignObject
